cards.card_text: How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?" Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
cards.verse_text: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
